LanguageData.CG_Alpha_Desc: How much of what stands under a tree (pawns, weapons, items, corpses) shows through its canopy, the same under any number of trees. 0% makes canopies solid; 100% leaves trees fully below pawns.
LanguageData.CG_HideBetterTreesButton_Desc: Removes Better Trees' cursor-transparency button from the bottom-right controls. Its hotkey still works.
